# DefenseClaw access policies for Agent Substrate. Apply as a global owner.
# 1. Global: add DefenseClaw as viewer (inventory, live actor checks).
#    kubectl ate get access-policy --global -o yaml > global.yaml
#    add these members to its viewer binding, then: kubectl ate update access-policy --global -f global.yaml
#      - user:system:serviceaccount:dc:defenseclaw-gateway
#      - user:system:serviceaccount:dc:defenseclaw-controller
---
# Launcher atespace eng-payments: only DefenseClaw edits (create, fork, suspend, resume).
#   kubectl ate create atespace eng-payments   (if it does not exist)
#   kubectl ate create access-policy -a eng-payments -f this-document.yaml
metadata:
  name: default
bindings:
  - role: editor
    members:
      - user:system:serviceaccount:dc:defenseclaw-controller
      - user:system:serviceaccount:dc:defenseclaw-gateway
---
# Launcher atespace eng-web: only DefenseClaw edits (create, fork, suspend, resume).
#   kubectl ate create atespace eng-web   (if it does not exist)
#   kubectl ate create access-policy -a eng-web -f this-document.yaml
metadata:
  name: default
bindings:
  - role: editor
    members:
      - user:system:serviceaccount:dc:defenseclaw-controller
      - user:system:serviceaccount:dc:defenseclaw-gateway
---
# Managed atespace data-team: add DefenseClaw to the editor binding of its current policy.
#      - user:system:serviceaccount:dc:defenseclaw-gateway
#      - user:system:serviceaccount:dc:defenseclaw-controller
